name: Krea 2 Depth ControlNet
description: Adds Krea 2 Turbo / RAW Depth ControlNet models (Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet). Generates a new image that keeps the 3D structure of a Control Image. The depth LoRA is downloaded automatically into the Krea 2 LoRA folder.
author: WanGP community

info_card.description: Upload any photo or render: Krea 2 regenerates it from your prompt while keeping its depth, perspective and composition.
info_card.details: Requires Krea 2 (Turbo or RAW) and downloads the 862 MB depth Control LoRA on first use. Works best around 1 MP with real-perspective images.
